item.title: Professional Field Services Veterinarian East
item.description:
About Contura Vet and Its Portfolio

Contura Vet is a global Medical Technology company developing and manufacturing innovative hydrogel-based therapies across animal health.

Our portfolio includes Arthramid® and Mictamid™, both comprised of a 2.5% polyacrylamide hydrogel, designed to address distinct clinical needs across osteoarthritis and urinary incontinence due to urethral sphincter mechanism incompetence (USMI). Together, these technologies reflect Contura Vet’s commitment to advancing durable, science-anchored treatments that restore function and improve quality of life.

Contura Vet is focused on building a differentiated portfolio of therapies that target underlying pathology and deliver durable clinical outcomes across multiple therapeutic areas, grounded in a rigorous evidence-based approach.

Position Summary

The Professional Field Services Veterinarian serves as Contura Vet's field-based clinical and scientific expert, supporting the company's portfolio of innovative veterinary therapies. This role partners closely with Veterinary Services, Commercial, Marketing, and external veterinary professionals to provide evidence-based education, technical support, and scientific exchange that advances appropriate product utilization and improves patient outcomes.

Responsibilities include delivering clinical education and training, supporting field-based scientific exchange, contributing veterinary expertise to product lifecycle initiatives, developing technical resources, fostering relationships with key veterinary stakeholders, and supporting pharmacovigilance activities while ensuring accurate, compliant communication across all field engagements.

Key Responsibilities

Scientific & Clinical Expertise

•             Serve as the primary field-based technical and scientific expert supporting Contura Vet's portfolio of innovative veterinary therapies, providing expert guidance on disease management, patient selection, product utilization, procedural best practices, and clinical outcomes.

•             Provide expert guidance on patient selection, diagnostic evaluation, treatment planning, product dosing, procedural techniques, and outcome optimization appropriate to the company's therapeutic portfolio.

Veterinary Education & Training

•             Design, develop, and deliver comprehensive training programs for internal teams and veterinary customers focused on the safe and effective use of Contura Vet's product portfolio and associated clinical procedures, including anatomy, aseptic technique, injection procedures, procedural approaches, product preparation, handling, and complication management.

•             Educate veterinary teams on post-injection and long-term patient management, including monitoring of clinical response, activity or workload modification, rehabilitation planning, adjunctive therapies, owner/client communication, and expectation management.

•             Support the development and delivery of high-quality continuing education programs, including lectures, wet labs, and hands-on workshops at conferences, professional meetings, and industry events. Develop educational content that supports sound clinical decision-making, procedural competency, and the appropriate use of Contura Vet's therapies.

Field Support & Collaboration

•             Provide in-field clinical support and guidance to commercial teams, reinforcing scientific credibility and appropriate product utilization across veterinary practices and referral centers.

•             Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders across sales, marketing, medical, regulatory, and research teams to ensure consistent, accurate, compliant, and scientifically sound messaging.

Product Development & Lifecycle Support

•             Contribute veterinary expertise to product lifecycle initiatives through interpretation of clinical and scientific evidence, identification of unmet clinical needs, and support of future product development and portfolio expansion.

•             Assist in the development and refinement of therapeutic positioning, treatment guidelines, and clinical protocols relevant to the company's therapeutic portfolio and commercial strategy.

Technical Documentation & Knowledge Resources

•             Support the development and maintenance of technical resources, including clinical guides, injection protocols, technical bulletins, FAQs, competitive analyses, scientific summaries, and field-based educational tools.

•             Stay current on emerging therapies, industry trends, scientific literature, and regulatory developments related to relevant disease states, therapeutic areas, clinical procedures, emerging technologies, and veterinary medical practice.

Professional Engagement & Thought Leadership

•             Develop and maintain strategic relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), referral specialists, academic institutions, veterinary organizations, and other influential stakeholders to strengthen Contura Vet's scientific credibility within the veterinary profession.

•             Support clinical research initiatives, field trials, publications, scientific presentations, and scientific exchange activities related to Contura Vet's therapeutic portfolio and areas of clinical focus.

Pharmacovigilance & Compliance

•             Support field based pharmacovigilance activities by responding to technical product inquiries, recognizing and documenting adverse events, and collaborating with internal medical and regulatory teams to ensure compliance with reporting requirements.

Required Qualifications

•             Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM or equivalent) degree from an accredited veterinary college or university.

•             Board certification or advanced training in surgery, sports medicine and rehabilitation, lameness, orthopedics, or a related discipline is highly desirable.

•             Minimum of five years of clinical veterinary experience with demonstrated expertise in one or more disciplines relevant to Contura Vet's portfolio, including orthopedics, surgery, sports medicine, rehabilitation, internal medicine, or other applicable clinical specialties.

•             Demonstrated understanding of the animal health industry and the application of clinical evidence to veterinary practice.

•             Previous experience in Veterinary Services, Medical Affairs, or a comparable field-based scientific role is highly desirable.

•             Exceptional communication, presentation, and teaching skills, with a proven ability to translate complex scientific and clinical concepts into practical, customer-focused education and guidance.

item.title: Administrative Assistant
item.description:
Administrative Assistant Department: Operations

Location: Hybrid 4 days in office Open to candidates residing in New Jersey (NJ) (with up to 5% travel)

Employment Type: Full-Time

About Contura and Arthramid® Contura is a global medical device company developing and manufacturing innovative treatments for joint pain and lameness. Unlike conventional therapies that mask pain, our approach targets the synovial membrane to restore joint function and mobility. Lameness is the leading cause of veterinary appointments and is often challenging to manage long-term. This can result in reduced performance, diminished quality of life, frequent re-treatments, and increased drug use. Arthramid® Vet is a unique and patented 2.5% iPAAG hydrogel with a precise therapeutic effect on the synovium. Synovitis is recognized as the single most significant factor contributing to the pain of osteoarthritis, making Arthramid® a breakthrough in veterinary care.

Position Summary Contura Vet USA Inc. is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Administrative Assistant to provide comprehensive administrative support and help ensure smooth day-to-day operations across multiple departments. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys managing diverse responsibilities, and takes pride in staying organized and responsive. The Administrative Assistant will support scheduling and calendar management, coordinate meetings, assist with event logistics, manage shipping of materials and supplies, handle internal and external communications, and maintain accurate records and documentation. This position plays a key role in supporting cross-functional teams and keeping operations running efficiently as the organization continues to grow.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage calendars, coordinate meetings, and support meeting logistics to ensure workflows remain organized and deadlines are met

• Handle phone calls, emails, and other correspondence while prioritizing urgent matters and maintaining a professional tone

• Maintain and organize digital and physical files, records, and documentation for accuracy and easy retrieval

• Prepare reports, presentations, spreadsheets, and supporting materials by compiling and formatting data clearly and professionally

• Coordinate shipping of materials, samples, supplies, and event-related items; assist with inventory tracking and replenishment

• Order office and operational supplies, monitor inventory levels, and support equipment or materials needed for wet lab and education programs

• Assist with data entry and basic bookkeeping tasks, including invoice tracking, documentation collection, and routing for approval

• Liaise with vendors, clients, and internal teams to share information, schedule meetings, and support ongoing operations

• Handle sensitive information, company records, and financial documents with confidentiality, accuracy, and discretion.

Required Qualifications

• Education: Associate’s degree required; Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent professional experience.

• Experience: Minimum of 2–4 years of administrative or operations support experience in a fast-paced environment.

Skills & Competencies

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams

• Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities

• Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills

• High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy

• Proven ability to meet deadlines and manage a high volume of work

• Strong problem-solving skills and sound judgment

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint), email platforms, and data entry systems

• Comfort learning new systems, tools, and processes (e.g., accounting, CRM, or project management platforms)

• Professional demeanor with the ability to remain composed under pressure

Work Requirements

• Reliable high-speed internet connection and a professional remote workspace

• Availability during core U.S. business hours

• Ability to sit, type, and communicate for extended periods, with reasonable accommodation per ADA guidelines

• Occasional travel (up to 5%) for meetings, events, or training as needed

Work Environment

• Hybrid role within a collaborative, mission-driven virtual team.

• Fast-paced, evolving environment where individual contributions have direct operational impact.

• Dynamic and innovative organization with a strong focus on improving animal health.

Compensation & Benefits

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.

• Paid time off (vacation, sick leave, and holidays).

• Professional development and training opportunities.

Equal Opportunity Employment Statement Contura is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other protected status under applicable law. We offer a welcoming and inclusive environment in service to one another, our products, the diverse consumers we represent, and the communities we call home. We do all of this with kindness, empathy, and respect for each other.

How to Apply Please submit your resume and cover letter. In your application, highlight your relevant experience and skills that make you a strong fit for this role.
